html:
Why managers switch cleaners

Most property managers do not leave a cleaner because of one bad visit. They leave after the third email from a tenant saying the baseboards or the shower were still dirty. The fix is a crew that works by checklist and by hand. Brazilian house cleaning in Greer is that kind of crew, and it fits rental properties well.

The method, briefly

Every surface is hand-wiped, not just sprayed. Corners and baseboards are done by hand. Furniture and small items are moved and cleaned under. Door frames, switches and handles are detailed, bathrooms are scrubbed including grout and the toilet base, and the kitchen is degreased: stovetop, hood and cabinet fronts. Floors are washed by hand along the walls, and a final walk-through checks the room list. That last step is useful for you, because it gives you something concrete to compare against.

Matching the visit to the property

Property typeHow the visit is planned
Occupied long-term rentalRecurring detail clean agreed with the tenant
Vacant unit between tenantsMove-out clean of the empty home
Furnished or short-term rentalTurnover checklist and fixed visit windows
Home after repairsPost-construction cleaning before detail work

Greer rentals include older houses near Downtown Greer and Trade Street and newer homes near GSP Airport and the BMW plant. Older hardwood and tile grout benefit most from hand work.

What to put in your own checklist

  • Number of bedrooms and bathrooms, and any rooms to skip
  • Pets in the lease, so the team can plan for hair
  • Access: lockbox, key or tenant present
  • Appliances that need interior cleaning
  • Photo needs after the clean, for your records
  • Who pays: owner, manager or tenant

The detail-first method changes what a manager sees after a visit. Instead of a home that looks acceptable from the doorway, you get one that holds up when someone opens a drawer, lifts a rug or runs a finger along a baseboard. That matters at lease renewals, when a tenant is deciding whether to stay, and at inspections, when you may need to prove condition. It also gives you a basis to ask a tenant to maintain their end.

It is worth separating what the owner pays for from what the tenant handles. Some owners schedule a deep clean once a year and ask tenants to keep up in between. Others include a monthly visit for a furnished property. Either arrangement works as long as it is written down and each party knows what the visit includes.

Before the first visit, send us a short list of known problem spots, such as a stained tub, a sticky cabinet or a rental with heavy pet hair. We plan the first visit around them and report back on what we found, so you can decide whether a deep clean is worth adding.

How much does cleaning cost for a Greer rental?

Perfect Services does not publish a price list because the factors differ for every property. They include home size, the level of detail (regular or deep), the frequency of visits, the number of bathrooms and the condition on the first visit. Recurring visits are less per visit than single ones. We give the exact price after a free in-home estimate, a short visit with no commitment. Request one through the Greer booking form, call (864) 399-5168 or text (864) 666-8520.

For short-term rentals, the pattern changes. Guests judge a stay by the bathroom, the kitchen and the bed, and a reviewer will notice a missed hair or a smudge on the mirror. A turnover checklist that lists the bed, towels, trash, the fridge and the floors in a fixed order gives you the same result every time, even with different guests and different arrival times. Tell us your check-in and check-out windows so the visit fits.

For occupied rentals, a courtesy message from you to the tenant before the first visit avoids confusion. It can say who is coming, when and what the visit covers. We are happy to help draft it.

How long it takes

First visits take the longest because the team is learning the home. After that, a recurring clean is more predictable, and you can plan your showing and turnover days around it. Greer is a short drive up I-85 and US-29 from many rental areas, so scheduling does not usually depend on travel time.

Many owners worry that a hand-detailed clean costs more time than they have. In practice it replaces re-cleans: when the first visit is thorough, you stop paying for the second visit to fix what was missed. The estimate visit is a good time to say which units cause you the most callbacks so we focus there first.

If you have units near GSP Airport or the BMW plant, where tenants often have short or rotating leases, the same checklist keeps handoffs quick between one occupant and the next.

A word on trust

Ask any cleaner for references you can verify, and ask what the team does when something breaks or goes missing from a property. A clear answer tells you more than a brochure. Ours is simple: we report it the same day, in writing, with photos where possible.

Handing over keys is a real decision. Perfect Services is a Brazilian-owned local team, and we agree on access in writing and keep the checklist consistent from visit to visit.
